design.test: FinaleDB publications 1 ([1, 7, 9]), 7 ([1, 7, 9]), 9 ([1, 7, 9]) -- blood plasma only, never trained on
design.data_source: public FinaleDB REST API + public S3 fragment objects; no IRB, no data-use agreement
design.harmonization: per-matrix z-score (each publication normalized by its own feature statistics)
design.classifier: PCA(n_components=200) + LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000), fitted on the training cohort only
design.labels: FinaleDB disease field: a diagnosis ending in 'cancer' -> cancer; Healthy / Hepatitis B / Cirrhosis / inflammatory bowel disease / SLE / liver transplant -> non-cancer control

training_derived_threshold.note: threshold fitted on the training cohort's out-of-fold scores; used to score case-only external publications

9.reason: case-only publication (no non-cancer controls in this study); reported as sensitivity at the training-derived threshold

honest_framing: The test publication was never used for training, feature extraction statistics, or hyper-parameter selection. This is an external validation on public data, not a clinical validation: the non-cancer arm is small and comes from different publications than the cancer arm in places, so the pooled AUC mixes a study shift with a cohort-composition shift. Read the per-publication and per-disease rows before quoting the pooled number.
